title: LeBron James shines in pre-season debut for re-tooled 76ers
summary: NBA superstar LeBron James delivered a solid first half in his first pre-season game for Philadelphia on Thursday, but the new-look 76ers fell, 114-108, to the Nets in Brooklyn.
